arguments.message: Hi! A genuine Meridian invoice will always appear in your account under **Settings → Billing → Invoices**. If the invoice you received by email doesn’t match any invoice shown there – for example the amount, plan, seats, or billing period are different – it’s considered unverified and could be fraudulent. We recommend not paying it until you confirm it in the Billing → Invoices view or contact us for verification.
